lines: Chicago, Archer Avenue. Never pick up a girl in a white dress.
Drivers have told this story for almost a hundred years.
Legend says she is the ghost of a young woman named Mary.
She dances with a stranger at a ballroom. Her hand is ice cold.
Then she asks for a ride home, down Archer Avenue.
He drives. She says nothing. The night grows colder.
At the gates of Resurrection Cemetery, she whispers: stop here.
She steps out, walks through the iron bars, and is gone.
In 1976, people say scorch marks appeared on those very bars.
Would you have given her a ride?
title: Never Pick Up The Girl In The White Dress On This Road 😨 #shorts
description:
For almost a century drivers on Chicago's Archer Avenue have told of a girl in white who asks for a ride home and vanishes at the cemetery gates. This is the legend of Resurrection Mary.
